name: Overgrown Viper Vine
senses: tremorsense is precise in area A7

perception.note: Low light vision, Tremorsense 60ft imprecise, tremorsense is precise in area A7

defensiveAbilities.name: Cold Vulnerability
defensiveAbilities.description: When exposed to a cold effect, the viper vine is overwhelmed by lethargy, becoming Slowed 1 for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Captivating Pollen
offensiveAbilities.description:
The viper vine releases a 60ft Emanation of invisible pollen that stays in the air for 5 rounds unless dispersed by a moderate or stronger wind. Each creature that enters or starts its turn in the area must attempt a DC 33 Will Saving Throw save or be captivated.

The viper vine can't use Captivating Pollen for 1d4 rounds.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune to Captivating Pollen for 24 hours.

Success The creature is Sickened 1.

Failure The creature is Fascinated, and it must spend each of its actions to move closer to the viper vine as expediently as possible while avoiding obvious dangers. If a captivated creature is adjacent to the viper vine, it stays still and doesn't act. It ceases to be fascinated if it's no longer in the pollen aura at the end of its turn.

Critical Failure As failure, plus the creature is Stupefied 2 for 24 hours.

offensiveAbilities.name: Constrict
offensiveAbilities.description:
(3d8+8) Bludgeoning Damage damage, Basic DC 35 Fortitude Saving Throw

See rules...

The monster deals the listed amount of damage to any number of creatures Grabbed or Restrained by it. Each of those creatures can attempt a basic Fortitude save with the listed DC.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grasping Roots
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger a creature attempts a Move action in area A7

Requirements the overgrown viper vine is in area A7

Effect The viper vine manipulates its roots to cause foliage around the triggering creature to suddenly seem to spring to life. The triggering creature must attempt a DC 35 Reflex Saving Throw saving throw.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target treats the first square of its movement as difficult terrain.

Failure The target becomes Immobilized by the foliage, (Escape dc=35 DC 35).

Critical Failure As failure but the target also falls Prone.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
